ceo.name: Salman Adeeb
ceo.bio:
I am the CEO of Adeeb Technology Lab. I'm a developer, graphic designer, video editor and cybersecurity expert, and I have been working in technology for almost eight years.

I have worked with organisations including IUB, AndroidBull, Raham TV and GCT Bahawalpur. Today our team designs and builds mobile apps for colleges, media brands and businesses, from the first idea to the store launch and beyond.

process.title: Discuss your app idea
process.text: Tell us about your idea on WhatsApp or a call. We learn who will use the app, what they need to do in it and which platforms you need.

process.title: Plan and design the screens
process.text: We list the features, map how users move through the app and design every screen. You approve the look before we write any code.

process.title: Develop
process.text: We build the app, its backend and the admin panel, and share test builds so you can try progress on your own phone.

process.title: Test on real devices
process.text: We test on different phones, screen sizes and Android or iOS versions, check speed and offline behaviour, and fix every issue before launch.

process.title: Publish to the stores
process.text: We prepare the store listing, icon, screenshots and privacy policy and publish the app on Google Play and the App Store under your account.

process.title: Support and updates
process.text: We stay available for updates, new features, store policy changes and support after launch.

projects.title: The Computer Courses BWP
projects.summary: A Flutter app for The Computer Courses, where students browse courses, books and campuses and contact the institute from their phones.
projects.description:
The Computer Courses BWP app brings the institute’s courses, books and campuses into one app, published on Google Play.

Students can browse more than 20 courses, from freelancing, graphic design and video editing to web and app development, cyber security and machine learning, see what each course covers and which campus offers it, and get in touch with the team. The institute also has a companion website.
features: Course catalogue with the tools covered in each course
Separate course lists for the Bahawalpur and Islamabad campuses
Books section and campus details
Welcome and onboarding screens
Contact and About us screens

coverImage.alt: Bs.IS Online Attendance System feature banner: login, home and attendance screens of the app

projects.title: Bs.IS Online Attendance System
projects.summary: An Android attendance app for the Department of Information Security, where each teacher signs in and marks class attendance from their phone.
projects.description:
We built this attendance app for the BS Information Security class and published it on Google Play.

Each teacher signs in to open their own attendance sheet. Records are kept in Google Sheets, so the department can review attendance without any extra software.
features: Teacher sign-in that opens each teacher’s own attendance sheet
Attendance records kept in Google Sheets
Built-in form and class information screens

coverImage.alt: ATLab Office Remote feature banner: the remote with all devices on and all devices off

projects.title: ATLab Office Remote
projects.summary: An Android remote that switches office lights and devices on and off over Bluetooth through an Arduino-based controller.
projects.description:
ATLab Office Remote turns a phone into a remote for office or home automation. It connects over Bluetooth to an Arduino-based controller, such as one with an HC-05 or HC-06 module, and each button sends a command that switches a device on or off.

It works offline with paired devices and is published on Google Play.
features: Connects to Arduino Bluetooth modules (HC-05 / HC-06)
On and off buttons for up to 9 devices
Works offline with paired devices
Simple, clear layout

coverImage.alt: ArbabNet Provider feature banner: features of the customer app and the admin panel

projects.title: ArbabNet Provider
projects.summary: An ISP management app with a customer panel and an admin panel for packages, payments, support tickets and notifications.
projects.description:
ArbabNet Provider is a complete app for an internet service provider. Customers see their connection status and plan, browse packages, subscribe or renew by bank transfer with a receipt upload, and raise support tickets.

The admin panel lets the provider manage users, verify payments, handle tickets, edit packages and send push notifications. It is built with Flutter and Firebase.
features: Customer dashboard with connection status and plan details
Subscribe, change or renew packages with bank transfer receipt upload
Payment and package change history
Support tickets and FAQ
Biometric login
Admin panel for users, payment verification, tickets and packages
Broadcast push notifications

coverImage.alt: Jan Cable TV & Internet feature banner: what subscribers can see in the app

projects.title: Jan Cable TV & Internet
projects.summary: An Android app for Jan Cable TV & Internet subscribers to sign in and check their package, remaining data and expiry date.
projects.description:
We built this app for Jan Cable TV & Internet, a local cable and internet provider. Subscribers sign in to see their package details, remaining data, speed and expiry date without logging in to a web portal.

The app uses Firebase for accounts and data, with Google sign-in, biometric login and push notifications.
features: Sign up and sign in, including Google sign-in
Dashboard with package, remaining data, speed and expiry date
Payment records
Biometric login
Push notifications

coverImage.alt: Pak Info Database feature banner: bill checks, vehicle, NTN, passport, licence, parcel and FIR services

projects.title: Pak Info Database
projects.summary: An Android app that gathers everyday online services in Pakistan in one place: bill checks, vehicle and NTN verification, passport and licence inquiries and parcel tracking.
projects.description:
Pak Info Database brings the online services people in Pakistan use most often into one app, so they don’t have to search for each website.

Users can check electricity, Sui gas and internet bills, verify a vehicle, look up an NTN, make passport and driving licence inquiries, track parcels and reach e-challan and online FIR services, all inside the app. We first built it in Java and later rebuilt it in Flutter.
features: Electricity, Sui gas and internet bill checks
Vehicle verification and NTN inquiry
Passport and driving licence inquiries
Parcel tracking
E-challan and online FIR services
Each service opens in an in-app browser

projects.title: DAE CIT Books

projects.description:

The app also includes the course syllabus, objectives and teacher information. It was previously published on Google Play.
features: Books for 1st, 2nd and 3rd year, organised by year
Course syllabus and objectives
Teacher information

coverImage.alt: IUB Portals New Tab feature banner: the student dashboard with clock, weather and IUB portal links

projects.title: IUB Portals New Tab
projects.summary: A Chrome extension that turns every new tab into a student dashboard for IUB, with university portals, live info and productivity tools.
projects.description:
IUB Portals New Tab replaces Chrome’s new tab page with a personalised dashboard for students of The Islamia University of Bahawalpur.

It puts My IUB, the E-Portal and the LMS one click away, next to university announcements, live weather, a clock, bookmarks, a to-do list and AI tool shortcuts. Everything runs in the browser, with no backend server.
features: One-click access to My IUB, E-Portal and LMS
Announcement slider for fees, admissions, merit lists and transport
Live clock, weather and time-of-day greeting
Multi-engine search bar
Bookmarks, to-do list and AI tool shortcuts
Theme-switchable glass design

coverImage.alt: Adeeb AI Voice Interview Agent feature banner: the interview join screen in the browser

projects.title: Adeeb AI Voice Interview Agent
projects.summary: A Windows app that runs AI-assisted voice interviews in the browser, with configurable questions, speech recognition and an admin interface.
projects.description:
Adeeb AI Voice Interview Agent runs AI-assisted voice interviews on a Windows PC through a local browser interface. Candidates answer by voice, the app transcribes what they say and replies with text-to-speech.

Companies set their own interview questions and company information and manage everything from an admin interface. An optional temporary link lets people join from a phone or another device.
features: AI-assisted voice interview flow
Speech-to-text with Faster Whisper and text-to-speech with Edge TTS
Configurable interview questions and company knowledge
Admin interface
Optional temporary link for access from a phone or another device
Built-in setup, repair and system-check scripts

projects.title: Adeeb Tech Lab New Tab
projects.summary: A Chrome new tab for the Adeeb Technology Lab community, with free course links, registration forms, search and quick tools on every new tab.
projects.description:

Every new tab shows links to our free courses, registration forms for teachers, jobs, internships and courses, a Google search bar, the time, date and weather, and quick links to Google apps and AI tools. It is lightweight and built without heavy frameworks.
